newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse ends higher, volume falls further.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse ends higher, volume falls further.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange All-Share Index rose slightly on Monday but most prices were unchanged and volume was extremely low, even by recent standards.
The exchange's market report showed that only 29,890 shares traded, down from 46,070 on Friday.
Mechanical Lloyd and Unilever rose five cedis each to 145 and 960 respectively. That, plus a gain of 20 cedis to 550 in Ghana Commercial Bank was enough to nudge the index higher.
The only faller was Mobil Oil, which dropped 110 cedis to 6,290, with just 300 shares traded. ($ = 2165 cedis) -- Abidjan newsroom, +225 21 90 90
